results.title: Più visibilità agli estremisti che ai parlamentari, l'impatto del “filtro” di Meta sulle elezioni
results.snippet: Coverage of Professor Fabio Giglietto's study, 'Meta's Political Content Reduction Policy and Italian Parliamentarians' Facebook Visibility', which examines how Meta's algorithmic content filtering suppressed Facebook visibility for elected parliamentarians while boosting extremist accounts.

results.title: Referendum. Bonelli e Fratoianni (Avs) scrivono al Presidente Agcom, preoccupati per le fake news veicolate sui social
results.snippet: Media coverage reporting on an official appeal by Italian politicians to AGCOM citing Fabio Giglietto's research on Meta's algorithmic political content reduction policy and its impact on public discourse and disinformation.
